profile.description: Family-focused county fair serving Rugby and Pierce County. HAFFE describes the event as “Family Fun for Everyone” and listed the 2026 fair for June 25–28. The fair’s 2027 dates and vendor/entertainment application timing were not published as of August 31, 2026.

notes.subject: 2027 prospect research — reviewed August 31, 2026
notes.body: HAFFE lists Pierce County Fair in Rugby as “Family Fun for Everyone,” with 2026 dates of June 25–28, the fair contact phone 701-208-0830, and PO Box 391. Public North Dakota legislative testimony identifies Khloe Sobolik as secretary of the Pierce County Fair. No official 2027 dates or application opening were found. Sources: https://www.heartlandassociationffe.com/members/view/pierce-county-fair/ and https://ndlegis.gov/assembly/69-2025/testimony/SAVA-1591-20250313-41160-F-SOBOLIK_KHLOE_K.pdf

notes.subject: EMAIL DRAFT — review only; do not send
notes.body:
Subject: Pierce County Fair — early 2027 Adventure Zone planning

Hi Khloe,

It was great meeting you through the HAFFE convention. Pierce County Fair’s family-focused approach in Rugby looks like a natural fit for The Adventure Zone, so I wanted to reach out early as 2027 planning develops.

We bring a fully staffed inflatable bounce house carnival, with setup, operation, and teardown included. We can discuss a prepaid package or, where appropriate, a pay-for-play arrangement. Are you considering an interactive family attraction area for 2027, and would you be open to a short conversation when your dates and plans are taking shape?

Best,
Desiree
The Adventure Zone
America’s Best Inflatable Bounce House Carnival

followUps.label: Review 2027 Pierce County Fair outreach
followUps.reason: Check for official 2027 dates and any vendor or entertainment application opening. Review the prepared email for Khloe Sobolik; do not send automatically.
